annotations.title: Who is getting FDA clearance in this device category?

description: Use when the user is sizing competition in a medical device category, diligencing a medtech target, or asks who is bringing devices to market: "how many pulse oximeters got 510(k) clearance?", "which companies are clearing devices under product code DQA?". Returns FDA 510(k) decisions per year from openFDA, whether they are rising or falling, and the most active applicants. Clearances, not sales. Refuses before you are charged if the category matches nothing. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: by year (years); segment: product_code or device. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For recalls in the category, use run_recall_watch.

device.description: A device phrase matched against device names, e.g. "pulse oximeter". Give this or product_code.

product_code.description: The FDA three-letter product code, e.g. "DQA". Give this or device.

years.description: Complete calendar years to cover, ending last year. Default 6.

name: run_device_clearances
